content: We need to find a template that matches retrosynthetic step: target is sulfonamide formed from aromatic amine + phenylsulfonyl chloride. The forward reaction: amine attacks S of sulfonyl chloride, Cl leaves, N-S bond formed, S-Cl broken. So functional groups formed: sulfonamide (N-S). Broken: sulfonyl chloride (S-Cl). So we can search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_formed includes "sulfonamide"? Need to see available functional groups list. Use get_available_functional_groups.
